findings.description: The '-final-' infix in the filename is atypical for docs/dev. All other docs/dev SOP files follow the pattern '<type>-<TASK-ID>.md' (e.g. apply-sop-c1-redev-20260505-001500.md, recovery-script-patches-20260513-211054.md). The '-final-' qualifier is a human-oriented signal that the previous Cycle 1 SOP was superseded, but it is not part of the established naming convention in this folder. The correct pattern would be 'recovery-script-patches-20260514-143000.md'. Advisory only — no blocking cleanliness issue, and the deviation is limited to this one file.

This file is a revised and significantly expanded successor to docs/dev/recovery-script-patches-20260513-211054.md (Cycle 1 SOP). The new file explicitly cross-references the older file ('Cycle 1 SOP being re-anchored: docs/dev/recovery-script-patches-20260513-211054.md'), and both files address M6, M8 patches to /root/bin/happy-session-recovery.sh with overlapping shell code blocks. The files are NOT byte-identical (different md5: 5e426e6c vs cf3dd04c; 187 lines vs 477 lines) and serve distinct roles (draft proposal vs final user-TTY SOP with BA-QA prescription resolution). The older file is therefore an archive candidate once the patches are applied. This is a pre-existing condition — docs/dev/recovery-script-patches-20260513-211054.md predates this diff.
